purpose: Compact, post-hoc presentation subset; not a replacement test benchmark or a statistically representative sample.
selection_basis: cover all six recorded benchmark groups
cover small, medium and large recorded sample sizes
cover different target cluster counts and recorded base-partition cluster-count ranges
inference_scope: all 53 datasets, averaged within each dataset over the same three frozen pools
